description: Returns the latest VR, AR, and XR headlines from VR.org's live aggregated feed (VR-native sources plus filtered general tech). Optionally filter by category and match a keyword in the title or snippet.

category.description: Optional category filter: hardware, gaming, software, enterprise, ar, or xr. Omit for all categories.

query.description: Optional keyword to match in the title or snippet.

name: search_vr_news
title: Search VR / AR / XR news
